title: Memory: Arena allocator (pointer bump, reset)
acceptance_criteria: Arena struct defined with base pointer, current pointer, and capacity
arena_init() allocates backing memory via mmap or brk syscall
arena_alloc(size, alignment) returns aligned pointer via pointer bump
arena_alloc() returns NULL when capacity exceeded
arena_reset() resets current pointer to base without freeing memory
arena_free() releases backing memory via munmap or brk syscall
Unit test verifies allocation, alignment, reset, and overflow behavior
